dkashāri zu3gdapal ldan rang gzhung bka' shag nas ched bsnyu da bstsal/par skrun gsal bshad/ dang sngo /rtsom sgrig pa'i gleng gtam/ bzhi pa/sdon gleng / brgyad pa/dang the / ngal rtsol ba'i khyim dang / byis pa'i dus kyi dran tshor/ 1gnyis pa/ pā lags btson 'jug dang gral rim pa'i zhwa mo/ 7gsum pa/ gyen log dang mnyam 'brel gyi 'khrug rtsodad/ 22bzhi pa/ rig dngos gtor bshig dang khyim rten dngos nor btsan bsdu/ 26lnga pa/ thodang khyer shar phyo gas yul kung kung hrer las zhugs/ 36drug pa/ rgya gar du gnas mjal dang phra da du zhi rgol/ 46bdun pa/ dmag sgar btso na khang du btson 'jug gi rgyud rim/ 60brgyad pa/ rgu+o tshar sdod ring dang nga'i khyim tshang gi gad zu3gab// 102dasdo/ pa/ bros byol dang btsan byol gyi 'ace ba/ 145

par skrun gsal bshad/ dang po/par skrun gsal bshad/7spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchodag nas gsum bcu'i dus dran thengs 28 thog bstsal ba'i bka' slob nang/ ‘6de snga so so rang nyid kyi thog la gnas tshul mang po zhig byung ba dang / de bzhin gzhan zer rjes 'brangs ma yin pa'i khungs ldan gyi gnas tshul rang gis mthong thos byung ba dag tshang mas do snang chen pos yig thog tu 'god dgos // de 'dra ma byas na/ gnas tshul sdug bsngal ji snyed rang sgog myangs pa'i mi mang po zhig rim bzhin rdzogs 'gro yi yod/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus skabs shig la de'i tshe de'i dus sdug po zhe po zhig byung ba red ces spom tshig tsam ma gastodags gcig nas gnyis su brgyud pa'i gnas tshul zhib tshags su la'ang bshad rgyu med pa chags rgyu'i nyen kha 'dug der brten dngos byung lo rgyus rgyas bsdus gang yin yang yig thog la bkod de yig cha mang tsam 'don thabs byed dgos ’’zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don dang / lhag par btsan byol spyi tshogs nang tshogs sde dang mi sger gang rung nas deb rigs sna tshogs par skrun byas dang byed bzhin yod na yang las gzhi 'di'i

gnyis pa/ par skyun gsal bshad/sgyu ga dmigs bkar phyag las gnang mkhan med khar/ rang yul bod nang du gzhi rtsa'i smra brjod rang dbang tsam yang med na mi che'i lo rgyus ngag rgyun tsam las yig lnga ga 'god rgyu shin tu dka' bas skyid sdug mi 'dra ba rgyud pa'i mi tshe'i dngos myong dngos byung gi lo rgyus de dag dang thog rang gi skad yig thog gsog sgrub bgyis te 'di nas sngo da dbyin gnyis kyi lnga ga rim pas dpar 'grems byed thub na/ lo rgyus deb phreng kha thor du mi gnas par rjes rab klog pa po rnams la 'tshol bde dang / de bzhin mgon po gang nyid kyi dgongs gzhi rlabs po che sgrub thub pa ma zad/ lnga da kyi chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus rtsom sgrig dpar skrun gyi stodang cha bskang thub pa sogs la dmigs te 'di ga snu gas pas ngal ba 'khur blangs kyis las gzhi 'di 'bo 'dzugs bgyis te da bar chab srid btson pa'i lo rgyus deb phreng bdun pa bar dpar skrun bgyis zin pa dang / da dung par skrun zhu 'char mang dag gcig sku da khongs nas da res chab srid btson pa'i 'o/ rgyus deb phreng brgyad pa 'di bzhin lha sa ba a ma bsku da nams dzadas lha na gyi 'o/ rgyus 〈dra〈2) rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsod zhes pa 〉〉dngos su spyan 'bul zhu thub pa 'dis rgyal spyi'isteng bod don thog rgyab skyor gnang mkhan rnams dang / de bzhin bod nang gi yid skyod ba'i gnas stangs la nyams zhib gnang mkhan rnams la lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhir thugs phan gso/sa re/ lhag par wa da phyi nang du gnas

par skrun gsal bshad/ gsumapa/pa'i rang rigs gzhon skyes rnams la rgan rabs tshos ngo da rgyal khab dang mi rigs ched dka' ba gang 'dra spyad pa gsal rtewags kyis mes po'i khrag rgyun ded nas bod bstan srid rang dbang slar gso'i don du zungs khrag gsar pa zhig sbyin thub pa'i re ba byed bzhin yod/mtha' don wa da kyi chab srid btson pa'i 'o/ rgyus deb phreng brgyad pa par du skrun par rang zhung bka' shag nas ched brjod bka' drin bstsal ba dang / lo rgyus kyi bdag pos 'gan 'khur dang du blangs te mthar lo rgyus kyi sgrom gzhi dngos su bskrubs thub pa ma zad deb 'di'i ce ma sgrig pa bde srung nyams zhib las byed tshe ring bsku da nams lags nas las zhor dus chod chud gzon du ma btang bar sku ngal tshad med skyon pa phyogs mtshungs 'di ga'i rtsom sgrig pa dang las byed rnams nas 'phyar gru mnyam 'degs gnang ba'i 'bras bus mthar par skrun thub par bcos min snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu bcas/nge da kyi dgu bcu gsum las 'gul chodags pa'i tshogs gtso rgya ma ye shes rtogs ldan gyis/phra da rgyal 'o/ 2130 spyi lo 2004 zla 8 tshes 18 nyin/

rtsom sgrig pa'i smeng gtam/ bzhi pa/rtsom sgrig pa'i smeng gtam/bod kyi lo rgyus kyi dus yun hril por phyi sdod rang byung gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / nang bcud skye 'gro thams cad rang dbang bag phebs su phyi'i rgyal khab dang 'brel ba med par phal cher kher rkyang du gnas pas/ gcig byas na lnga bcu nga dgu lor rgya nag gis thodad la btsan 'dzul gyi chag sgo byung skabs phyi'i rgyal khab snu/sa phal cher bod la srung skyob kyi rgyab skyor byed pa'i 'gan 'khri gang yang ma mthong ba yin gyi red/deng skabs 'dzam gling hril por 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi thob thang la srung skyob byed pa'i rgyal spyi'i spyi chogs kyis btsan gnon gtong mkhan la 'gog rgol dang btsan gnon myong mkhan la srung skyob kyi sems 'khur byed pa'i skabs 'dir/ rgya nag gi 'go khrid ma'o tse tung gis bar lam lo rabs lnga bcu'i rjes dang brgyad bcu'i snga rol du gsod gtor btson 'jug dang gnya' gnon mnar gcod kyi drag spyod kho nas ngo da mi'i sems pa 'dul thabs byas te/ dka' sdug kho na'i 'og bod mi 'tsho sdod byed dgos byung yang / ma'o tse tung shi rjes ting zha'o phing gis de snga'i ma'o tse tung gi drag spyod lam nas mi sems 'dul thabs med pa gsal po mthong

lnga pa/ rtsom sgrig pa'i jeng gtam/ ste dpal 'byor bslu brid kyi lhug gtong srid jus bzung ba rgya nag gi dpon rigs rim pa'i gzhung 'dzin 'og deng skabs bod nang 'phrad bzhin pa'i dza drag gi dka' rnyog che shos ni/ bod kyi chos rig rtsa med dang / gter rigs sngog 'don gyis rang byung khor yug la gnod skyon gtong ba'i nyen tshabs can gyi bya spyod mtshams 'jog yong rgyu dang zlog thabs yod pa'i gnas stangs 'di dag la 'tshe ba med pa'i lam nas gasnga nga len mthar phyin bya rgyur/ 7bo nga sa 7skyabs mgon chen sngo mchodag gis yang dag pa'i dbu khrid lam ston codag bod nang gi thodad rigs mi mang choms rgya mi'i btsan gnon dang gdug rtsub codig gzhi rgya che zhing shugs dragache ba'i rngam ston khrom skor rim par byas pa dang / khong tshos gdug rtsub che ba'i dmar po'i gzhung 'dzin 'og rang gi mngon 'dod sgrub rgyur 'gog rgol yong rgyu ma zad/btson 'jug gi nyes chad phog rgyu dang / tha na rang nyid kyi tshe srog gang sku nga la cho da dpag bya ma thub pa shes bzhin du/ sdug bsngal las bden pa 'cho la rgyur sems thag gtsang bcad kyis zhi rgol 'thab rtsod kyi rngam lha na khrom skor rim pa'i las 'gul thengs mang spel bas nyes med kyi rgyal gces bod mi mang po bden don 'thab rtsod las 'gul khrod rgya dmag gi mtshon cha'i 'og srogo shor ba dang / btson 'jug gis sdug sbyong mnar gcod drag po 'phag pa/

rtsom sgrig pa'i speng gtam/ drug pa/de na a ma lags khong yang phyi lo lnga bcu nga dgu nas gdug rtsub che ba'i chab srid kyi rlung 'tshub drag po dkrigs pa'i rgyud rim nang gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi rdung rdeg mnar gcod sna tshogs shig phog nas rang gi pha ma gnyis kyang gdug rtsub gnya' gnon che ba'i spyi tshogs nang rkyen 'das su gyur/ khong rang nyid kyang bden don 'thab rtsod nang zhugs te 'dzin bzung bce na bcug gis sdug sbyong mnar gcod phog pa ma zad/ khong gi bza' zla dang / bu phrug bu mo'i bza' zla bcas rim par btson bcug byas pa dang / khyim tshang gi phyi nang du sngog bsher gyis ca dngos bsres gtor ni dmag chen zhig gi mjug 'bras dang gnyis su ma mchis/khong btson 'jug do dam 'og gnas bzhin pa'i skabs khong gi bza' zla dang tsha mo rkyen ngan gyis 'das hrongs song ba dang / khong dang bu mo nyi ma btson 'jug do dam 'og yod pas bu mo 'chi med ni sdug bsngal mi bzod par smyon ma ltar dran tshor med pa'i gnas su lus/ khong gi khyim tshang gi ya nga ba'i god chags rim pa'i spyi chodags gnas stangs la mtshon na/de'i dus de'i tshe 'gro ba mi'i thob thang zer ba ni brjod thabs med par gyur ba zhika red la/ skabs der khong gi sems khong du byung ba'i sdug bsngal rnams lag mthil gyi ri mo bzhin blta na thub tshe bsam gzhigs can su yin yang rang dbang med par mig chu shor rgyur nges/ khyim tshang nang god chags

bdun pa/ lcangam sgrig pa'i snyeng gtam/ —de lta bu byung yang drang sems med pa'i rgya mi dmar po'i khrims 'og nas khong glod mi srid la/ g.yol thabs med par btson bcug ro/ dam codag sdod dgos byung / khong gi gyod gzhi'i thog gzhung drang can gyi dri gcod pa tshos mi chos ring lugs kyi srid jus snga na dngos kyi khrims lugs lag bstar snga na 'khyol sku nga ba byas te khong gi khyim tshang stong nyen gyi dza drag gnas bab las skyodab rogs kyis gnas skabs khyim skyodang du spyodad bkrol btang / khong dang khong gi bu bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis btson khang nang rdung rdeg mnar gcod phog ste nad mnar dza drag tu yod pa'i bu mo nyi mar sman bcos nad g.yodag dang / smyon ma ltar gyur ba'i bu mo 'chi med drag skyed ched rim 'gro sman bakhyodas byed bzhin pa'i khar/ bu bstan 'dzin mi ngan zhig gis dbang gnon gyis gri brgyab ste tshe sku ga bcad pa'i gnas tshul de byung rjes kho nga sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nang tshud nas yid gdung gis sems khams mi bde bar skabs de'i gnas tshul drangs skabs ha cang skyo nyams kyis ngu skad 'don pa ma zad/ skad gdangs dma' zhing zhum pa'i nyams kyis dbugs ring nar nar du 'byin chas zhib mor dri rgyu dka' ngal ha cang che/phyi lo 20()4 lo'i zla 7 tshes 14 nyin/rda ram sa la nas/ tshe bsod kyis/

sngon smeng / brgyad pa/sngon gleng /rgya gung khran gyis bod la dmag dpung drangs te bod shar phyogs nas 'go brtsams te rim bzhin mug bzos btsan 'dzul rjes bod rgya nag gi mi ser spel yul du gyur nas/ btsan gce na myong mkhan bod mi mang gi dgra zla'i 'thab rtsod kyi mdung rtse'i ngo bo bod mi nang khul gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi rnam par kha phyogs bsgyur nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin dbang sgyur gral rim rtsa med bzos te srid dbang gi bdag po bod mi mang la yod/ gung khran ring lugs kyi 'go khrid 'og mang gtso dang spyi chogs ring lugs kyi bod gsar 'dzugs skrun byed rgyur ngo rgol gsum/ chag yangs gnyis/dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur so/gas ming 'dogs sna snu gas kyi las 'gul sne mang spel bas/ bod kyi lo rgyus nang ma grags pa'i dka' sdug gi dus skabs shig byung ba nga dang nga'i khyim tshang la'ang gcig mtshungs myang dgos byung / rang gi khyim tshang chung ngu gcig la mtshon na'ang pha ma nas phru gu bcas pa sdug sbyong btang / btson la bcug rang gis dka' las brgyab nas bsags pa'i rgyu sna ra yod tshad bcos bsgyur gyi ming thog nas btsan bsdu 'phrog bcom byas te rgya mi kho nga rang tshos mi mang la bcos sgyur btang

dgu pa/ sngon gleng /pa'i ngo gso btangad+ngha / pha mar kha'i phor pa med par rgya mi'i las khungs srang lam nas lcags phor the la ba bsgrugs te bed spyad byed dgos byung ba rgya mi gung khran gyis baphra sa pa dang / lhag don du skabs de'i 'a'o/ 'gyur che ba'i bod kyi spyi chodags khrod du rgya mi'i dpon rigs dang / las byed tsho'i byed spyod ni mi sems la bab par dka' ba'i gdug rtsub dang / dza drag la/ rno ngar che ba zhig yod pa ni ‘‘gral rim 'thab rtsod ’’kyi rdung rdeg de dag las gsal po shes rgyu yod/phyogs gzhan zhig nas drangs na/ 〈snad mi srog sgyu ga dang / bsnyu na 'jugatshe btson/ yun ring btso na khang du ngal rtsodal btsan 'gel/ wa da mi rnams btso na khang dang / yang na spyi cho gas steng mnar gcadad dang kha mi bral bar gnas dbo sa pa/ btso na 'jug byas pa'i sngo da mi ches mang ba mnar gcod kho na'i 'og mi tshe zad pa dang / lus gcong bzos te tshe mjug 'cho ngal 'phrad pa/ tha na rang nyid kyi pha ma dang / spun nye/ grogs bza' zla bu phrug bcas la ches brtse sems kyi bral kha'i skyod snang gi mig chu'i mchi zhag skyur nas mi 'phra da bzhin du lus la gang sbyar gyi bo sa gyon nas rang yul dang bral te btsan byol du yong dbo sa byung bas/ngas dngos mthong dngos myong gi rang thog tu snu nga ba rnams spyi tshogs de'i gnas bab masnu na rgyur ji bzhin yig thog tu 'god par mi nus kyang sne zin tsam rang nyid rang dbang lung par slebs te sus mi chor bar

sngon gleng / bcu pa//sdug sgom gyis 'dug pa las drang bden gyi gnas stangs de dag zhu 'ango da thengs gcig byed pa'i khor yug cig yod pa gal cher mthong ste rang nyid kyi mi tshe'i rgyud rim 'bri rin chog pa zhig med mod/ codan kyang 'das sku na bod mi dpa' bo pho mo'i chod sems kyi snying stodabs la yi rang dang / nga tshor byung ba'i dka' sdug gi mig chu'i byung ba rjes dran/gzhan yang bsub tu med pa'i don dngos kyi gnas tshul 'di dag phyi rabs gsar bu rnams dang phyi mi 55nga mas / khyim macenas rgya mi gung khran gyis rang btsan gtsang mar gnas pa'i ngo da rgyal khab btsan bzung gis thodad mir rta zog dud 'gro lta bu'i bkol spyod kyi gdug rtsub spyad pa shes rtogs yong rgyur gang dran sgro skur 'khyog brjod med par 〈〈mi rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsodad 〉〉ces pa phyi lo 1959 nas rgya mi'i btsan gnon 'og sdug sbyong myosneng dgos byung ba dang / bar du btson khang nang lus sems gnyis la bsun btsir gyi dka' ngal 'phrad pa/ mthar btsan byol gyi 'tsho bar spyad pa'i brgyud rim mdor bsdus kyi lo rgyus yin lags/ 'on kyang da lta'ang rgya dmar gyi btsan gnon bod nang gnas bzhin nga ra brten gnad don mang ngo/ zhig gsal bton ma thub par lus song na 'brel yod rnam pas dgongs 'chub yod pa zhu/bsod nams chodas sgron gyis/phyi 'o/ 2004 zla 8 tshes 10 nyin/

ngal rtsol ba'i khyim dang byis pa'i dus kyi dran tshor/ 1le tshan dang po/dāl rtsol ba'i khyim dang byis pa'i dus kyi dran chodar/gna' bo'i grong khyer lha sa ni lo ngo 1300 lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan zhing / bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byedar/ rig gnas sogs kyi lte gnas yin/ bod rang btsan gyi bskal ba bzang po'i dus su rgyal sa lha sa sogs bod mi 'dus sdod che ba'i sa khul khag tu tshong gnyer byed pa'i srol yod pa bzhin nga'i pha skal bzang yang dgung lo chung dus nas rang yul dang bral te lha sar phebs nas chodang las la zhugs/ khong skyes yul mdo stod go 'jo lha rgya g.yu byung tshang nas yin pa dang / pā lags la spun bdun yod pa nas khong gnyis pa yin/ ma slo bzang chos sgron ni skyes yul lha sa dang / pha ma gcig gi spun bzhi sku da pa'i nang nas chung shos yin/pā lags lha sar bzhugs skabs skyed ma dang ngo shes byung nas rang mos thog

da mi rabs sum gyi 'thab rtsoganyen sgrig byas pa zhig dang / a ma lags dgung lo nyi shu'i thog nga rang skyes/ nga'i pā lags dam pa sa gnas gang sar tshong las byed par bskyod cing skabs shig nas rgya gar phyogs su phebs te bod du mkho dgos che ba'i ca dngos ka lon sbug nas rgya zog ras cha dang / chu tshod/ lham/ rma bya'i sgro sogs sne rigs mi 'dra ba lha sar zong 'dren byed pa dang / mtsho sna gzhis kar nga'i a khu lags kyi a zhang gcig yod pas de phyogs kyi chodan khungs snam rigs sogs tshong 'dren gyis lha sa'i bsnyung gnas lha khang gi mdun der nga tsho'i tshong khang zhig btsugs yod pa nas sdeb tshong dang sil tshong byed kyi yod/nga'i pā lags tshong las thad 'jon thang che bas ka lon sbug nas mi gzhan gyis mi dga' zhe 'dzin gyis dug sprad pa'i rkyen ngan las lha sar phyir log rjes nga rang lo bcu gcig la son skabs khong 'das grongs su gyur/nga'i pā lags dam pa 'das grongs rjes khyim tshang gi 'gan khur sku ngas rdzogs a ma lags gcig pus gnang dbo sa byung zhing / 'o/ shas rjes khyim thab gsar pa blo bzang byams pa lags dang gnyen sgrig gis snga rjes phru gu lnga byung ba'i dang po gcung mo ye shes sgrol ma dang / gcung po byams pa chos grags/ gcung sngo ngag dbang chos grags/ gcung sngo mig dmar tshe ring / gcung po chung bdag bcas rim gyis skyes/ nga'i a ma

ngal rtsol ba'i khyim dang byis pa'i dus kyi dran tshor/ lags la khyon phru gu drug byung pa'i rgan rtsodas nga rang yin/ blo bzang byams pa lags khong nga'i pha min yang nga la pha lta bu'i byams khyodang dang brtse sems bocangs kyi sku da pas ngas kyang khong pha lta bur brtsis nas pā lags zhu yi yad/phyi lo 1940 lo tsam la nga'i pha ma gnyis nas stod lung bde chen rdzong bzang mo gzhon nu gdong gi son khal 400 tsam yod pa'i gzhis ka zhig nyos 'dug par/ rmod mdzo dor bdun dang / rta bdun/drel dgu/ bong bu lag bzhi/ de bzhin ra lug dang / ba phyugs sogs khyodan che zhig yod la/ gzhis kar las ka byed mkhan g.yog pho sma/ bcu drug tsam yod pa'i gras kyi ming dran gsos pa a zhang dang / bu mo rgan pa/ khra sil/ rkang btsugs/ rdo rje dbang grags/ a khu phur don/ bde khrang /bsam skyid/ bu chung / dbo zla ba/ bu gzhon/ rta mgrin/ sangs rgyas sogs yin/ nged tsho sbyin bdag dpon g.yog zhes 'tsho ba dbye 'byed med par skyid sdug mnyam cadang du gnas shing / de min gzhis kar las ka byed mkhan mo yan (gzhis kar sdod gnas g.yar ba'i las mi/) yang mang lnga/ zhig yod/sa gnas de rgyud du gzhis khag bcu gcig yod pa nas sa'i tig dang / sa chu yag pa/ thon khungs legs cadas nga tsho'i gzhis ka yin pas/'bru rigs nas dang / gro/ sran ma/ pad kha/ shob rtsa dang / rgya sran ma/

rā lags bcon 'jus dang gral rim pa 'i zha mo / 9kha shas yod pa ngas spyi pa'i gsang spyod nang g.yugs pa yin/ rgya nag btsan 'dzul pas bod mi'i rgyal gces gyen langs las 'gul la drag gnon byas te ngo rgol zhod 'jags rjes / pā lags bod mi spyi byings dang 'dra bar stod lung bde chen rdzong bzang mo gzhon nu gdong gzhis ka nas dngos grub steng la btson 'jug byas pa'i gnas tshul shes byung / pā lags la blta skyong thub ched a ma lags nged gnyis 'phral du grong khyer lha sa nas stod lung bzang mo gzhis kar bskyod skabs/ ngo rgol nang rgya dmag gis bod mi'i thog phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gang byung me sgyogs dang / me mda' brgyab ste nyes med bod mi rgan byis khri phrag brgal ba bsad rmas btang ste/ lha sa nas dan bag rin chen sgang gi grong sde bar gyi sa thog tu mi ros khengs shing / mi khrag gi sa gzhi dmar por gyur nas mi ro'i dkyil du 'gro skyod mi shes pa'i gnas stangs byung ba dus da lta yang mig lam la mngon sum du 'char gyi 'dugagazhis kar slebs pa dang pā lags grib btson khang du khrid zin pa dang / zhing khul de'i bod mi hūr brtson can rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi de dag ni rgya mi'i bslu brid mgo skor 'og tshud nas a ma lags nged gnyis la sdang zug ci cher byed pa ma zad kho pa tsho'i gang bshad la brtsi 'jog dang / bkod jus la nyan 'jog byed rgyu las bya thabs gzhan gang yang ma rnyed/

sa wa mi rabasagasum gyi 'thab rtsod/dbul phongs hur bce na can rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi de chodas ‘‘mi mang la bshu gzhog dang / gnya' gnon galta nga mkhan log rje da gral rim pa de tsho ngal ce la sgyur bkod byed dgos ’’zhes btsan 'gel drag pos a ma lags dang nged gnyis zhing khul der nyar nas lha sar phyir log byed du ma bcwag pa/sa/ dus de nas nga rang lo 32 la ma slebs bar gral rim khyim tshang gi zhwa mo'i 'og stod lung zhing khul du ngal rtsol sgyur bkod byas te bsdad dgos byung /ma'o tse tung gis ‘‘gral rim 'thab rtsod ni rkang red ’’ces rno ngar che la dza drag pa'i gral rim 'thab rtsodad kyi 'gran rtsod las 'gul khrod 'ud lha ga rlung yan gyis rkyen pas/ pā lags btson khang nas gza' 'khor gsum re'i mtshams phyir khrid yong ste mang tshogs la 'thab rtsod rdung rdeg byed du bcug pa dang / 'thab rtsod skabs de khyodan nga tsho'i gzhis g.yog chodas‘‘a ma lags dang pā ṅgegs yag po sku da/ 'thab rtsod byed mi dgos ’’bshad rung / yar langs zhing bran zhes 'bod pa'i dbul phongs hur brtson can rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi de dag gis nyan 'jog ma byas par nga'i pha ma gnyis la ya nga med pa'i 'thab rtsod dang / snying rje med pa'i rdung rdeg yang yang btang /rgya rigs las byed pa'i ngan jus dang bod rigs las byed pa'i skul slong ngan pa'i 'og hur brtson can gnas lugs mi shes pa/ mi rigs

pā lags btson 'jug dang gral rim pa'i zhwa mo / 11rig gzhung la goms 'dris med pa'i mi mang rnams ni rgya mi'i las byed tsho'i mgo skor gasku byus 'og hur btson can gyi lag char bed spyad de/ gdug rtsub kyi las 'gul khrod rgya las nga/ tshos dbul phongs hur brtson can tshor khyod tsho lo ngo mang po'i ring dbang sgyur gral rim 'og gnya' gnon dang /bshu gzhog gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs shig myangs dasku sa byung sku/da pas/ rgya che'i zhing bran dang bran g.yog rnams rmongs gnyid las sad de/ gsar brje'i spro snang tshor zhing gral rim gyi go rtogs shes nas sdug bsngal gyi 'byung rtsa bsngogs/ sdug bsngal gyi byung ba bgrangs te mnga' bdag gral rim gyi nag nyes ther 'don dang / khyod shi nga gson gyi gral rim 'thab rtsod kyi rlabs rgyun 'phyur ba'i las 'gul nang zhugs rgyu'i skul slong byas/dbul phongs hur brtson can rnams ni rang mi rigs nang khul rdung rdeg gtong du bcug par 'dod mos dang / dga' snang che zhing khog la gdon 'dre zhugs pa'am sme gab kyis yongs su sgrib pa lta bur gyur/lhag par pā lags bsgu na bcug do dam 'og gnas bzhin pa'i thodag a ma lags rkang nga/ thang po med kyang rgyun du ngal rtsol dka' tshegs che sa dang / nyen kha che sa la ‘d+nghagral rim pa 'gro dgos ’’zer gtong rkyang byed pa ma zad/ dgong mo ngal las nas phyir 'khor rjes slar yang mtshan mo phyi po'i bar rtag tu 'thab rtsod myong dgos pas mi yul la ma grags pa'i

1da mi rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsod/dka' sdug cig khong gis myangs dgos byung / a ma lags chod rgya che bas ma gtogs gdug rtsub de dag codag sdug bsngal dang sems sdug kho nas gson thabs bral ba'i sdug sbyong btang ba red/rdung rdeg 'thab rtsod gtong skabs de khul gyi gzhis khag bcu gcig gi mi mang rnams tshogs 'dur balhaṭangs/ gzhis khag bcu gcig de'i sde pa (gzhis dpon/)tshang ma khrid de lag pa rgyab la bsdams/ pus mo sa la btsugs bcug ste gral star du bzhag nas sngar gyi gzhis bran dang rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi de tshos so so'i sbyin bdag der sngon chad kyi byed lugs yag po med pa bgrangs nas nyes rdung 'thab rtsod gya nom pa zhig btang rjes zhor du de yod sde pa tshang mar rgyug pa leb rdung gis nyes rdung btang /skabs shig nga'i pā lags kyis myong bzhin pa'i nyes rdung gi dka' sdug nga'i mig lam 'char dus sems la skyo ngal dang dngangs skrag gis ma bzod par rdung rdeg gtong yul gyi sdings cha'i 'og nas langs te pā lags kyi mabo snga ra sbar mo yang bkab myong yod/ rgya nag gzhung gis zhing khul du ched gtong byas pa'i sems bzang can gyi las byed re gnyis yod pa tshos nga'i byed lugs la snying rje skyes dgos pa byung yod/ngas gsal por dran pa zhig la nyin gcig nga'i pā lags btson khang nas phyir khrid yong ste 'thab rtsod byas/ pā lags mnyam du sku drag

7zha mi rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsod/nas nga tsho ngo shes dang phan tshun nye po yod/ kha lo ba blo bzang dang khong gnyis kong po ba gcig yin stabs/ rnam kun nas nye po sku(da pas gnas tshul rnams bse da bkras la bshad pas gsal shes byung rjes bsku da bkras las gnas kyi go gnas kyang spar tshul sprodas byung /de rjes nged tshos sbas skung byas pa'i yig cha de dag stod lung nang len par 'gro ba'i nyin dang por nyen rtog gsang ba'i las khungs kyi mi sna rlangs 'khor btang nas dmag sgar btson khang du nged rang len par yong skabs/ dmag sgar gyi rgyal sgo'i kha thug der rlangs 'khor rdung thug gis skyon shor chen po byung bas de nyin bskyod ma thub par phyir log byed dgos byung ba red/nyin shas rjes bskyar du nyen rtog gsang ba'i las khungs kyi rlangs 'khor gsum mnyam khrid kyis yig cha len par khrid byung / de nyin nga tsho stod lung du bskyod pa'i lam bar gyi snum mdzod las khungs la ma slebs tsam du mdun lnga sa nas rgya mi ar las pa zhig rkang 'kho ra bzhon te yong ba dang nga tsho'i rlangs 'khor rdung thug byung song /cud krang rgya mi gcig yod pa rlangs 'khor nas babs te ar las pa rgya mi de'i mgo skra nas bzung ste ha las hang sang dgos pa zhig rdung bas ma tshad/ grang rlung 'ur 'ur du ldang ba'i khrod ar las pa rgya mi de'i am

dmag sgar btson khang du btson 'jug gi rgyud rim/ 7 phrag nas ar las las grwa'i dngul 'dzin red zer rlung bus shog 'dzar khur ba yang mthong byung / phal cher de nyin ar las pa rgya mi der dpal 'dre ra gyi gyon gun yang gang tsam sngo ga tshod yin/rlangs 'khor nang yod pa'i bod rigs nyen rtog pa tshos bar mi byed rtsis skabs nga rang btson pa yin pa'i snang ba g.yengs te/ kha langs thodar bas rgya mis rgya mi rdung bar/ bar mi byed dbo sa ma red ces kha nas thon song bas kha lo ba des nga'i ngo gdong la zhib mor bltas te gang yang mi zer/ phal cher der chu chodad gnyis tsam 'gor tshod yin/nga tsho de las thon ste stod lung bzang mor 'byor ba dang ngas yig cha sngog 'aro/na byed dgos byung ba de'i nang sa khra dang / rgya gar phyogs nas khyer yodang ba'i yig cha dang / deb/ brnyan 'khor/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen lnga mchodag gi bka' jo ba dang / mdzad rnam sogs rgya yig gi yig cha yang yod la/ dpar rgyag sku chas mang po zhig sku da pa nga'i mdun bkrams te par mang thag dzadad cig brgyab/btson 'jug byas rjes dmag lam gyi gsang ba'i sa khra de rgya mi'i lag tu thob pa de ni shin tu nas blo pham dbo sa pa zhig dang / nga tsho'i lag nas sa khra de thon par rgya dasngo na rnams hon thor te ro/ snang chen po'i thog nas nga la sa khra'i stodar skad cha yang yang dris pa dang / nyen rtog pas d+nghadzung la

7ji mi rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsod/skad cha drang po ma bshad na/ khyedad la srog thog gi nyes pa gcad rgyu zhes nag nyes chen po brtsis shing / sa khra de gang nas byung min ’’'dri rtsad thengs mang byas byung / ngas de'i skor dri zhib par gang yang ma bshad par bsdad pas/ skabs shig nas khong chodas nga la ‘6skad cha drang po bshad na khyod rang glod bkrol gtong rgyu yin ’’zer ba ni dri zhib pa tshos btson par mgo skor gyi thog nas skad cha dri ba'i thabs shes shig red/sa khra'i gnas tshul khong tshos shes pa ma zad sa khra kho nga tsho'i lag tu thob zin pas gnas tshul 'byung khungs thad thub bstan lags dang nged gnyis ra ma phrod pa'i gnas stangs shig sku nga rgyur nges pas ha cang gi sems ngal che stabs/ de'i thad nyin re bzhin dngangs skrag ji cher 'gro ba dang /ci bya ltos med kyis thabs gzhan med pas/ ngas dbang lags zhes dmag mi rang rigs btson pa lo chung zhig la rgya lha ra nyis brgya rngan par sbyin te thub bstan lags su sa khra de khyed rang gis nga la sprad byung zhes lab rgyu yin/khyed kyis ga nas byung min gsung rogs/ ngas de'i skor shes kyi med brjod rgyu yin zhes lan bskyal du btang ba yin/ dmag mi des khong la lan brda de sprad rjes nged gnyis don med ra ma mthun pa'i gnas tshul zhig yong rgyu min pas/ nyin zhig gi 'dri zhib skabs ngas dri zhib par sa khra de thub bstan lags kyis nga la phru gu'i phru ba deb kyi rgyab shar gnang byung / ngas yi ge

dmag sgar btson khang du btson 'jug si rgyud rim 75mi shes pas nge na dag gang yin shes kyi med byas pas/ tre da kyis yig cha mnyam du dam don byas te nyar tshags sbas skung byed snga na gang red zer nan pos btsan bkar byas shing / de'i thad lta nga tshos yid ches ma byas par nga la skad cha mang po dris/ 'on kyang ngas gong du bshad pa'i skad cha de rang mtha' skyel gyis bshad pas mtha' mjug gnas tshul dri thag chodad/tshe brtan lha ra rgyas lags ni skyes yul rgyal rtse gnas rnying nas yin pa dang / btson du ma tshud gong lha sa sbra nag zhol mgron khang bi/ tho 'kho/da pa red/ spyi lo 1989 lor btson 'jug byas/ dang thog rgu tsha btson khang du btson 'jug byas pa dang / rgu tsha nas dus bkag btson 'jug lo bzhi'i khrims thag bcad nas grwa bzhi btson khang du spo skyel byas te dus bkag ma rdzogs par btson khang der btson 'jug codag bzhugs dgos byung pa red/'grug pa brgyab nas dzadags ྅ gyur pa/res gza' nyi ma'i nyin zhig dmag sgar de'i bod dmag dpon rigs gcig gi bza' zlas/ phag sha rngod ma dang / bag leb/ /ba stob/ja sogs bsnams nas thabs shes sna chodags kyis nged rang btson sgo'i phyi la bton te kha lag de dag gnang / ngas khong la ‘ ‘khyed kyis nyen kha de

zag wa mirabasagasum gyi 'thab rtsod/'dra brgyud nas 'di ltar gnang mi dgos ’’zhus kyang / khong rang gis ༷/ tshugs ngang nas nga la kha lag yag thag chod ༷ sa te lus po 'tsho dbo sa pa nan gsung gnang ba dang / nged gnyis col sgros mol sgros shod gin kha lag ༷ sa te bsdad/ ༷/na tsam nas sna/ rang chab gsang du phebs song bas cung ma 'gor bar bsnyu na khang de'i 'bo dpon rgya dmag dpon rigs shig yod pa slebs/nged rang bathodan khang phyi ru bton yod pa mthodang ma thag rgya mi dmag dngo na de khro ba chen pos lag gi phu rung bzed gin nga'i phyogs su 'ong nas ‘‘khyod sus phyir bton song zer shor 'o/nga nas nga la gadze nga rgyag gzhus/the ga brdzis kyis brdungs/ ngas nyen lta ga pas bton song ’’byas pas/ khos ‘‘nyen rtog pa ga bar 'dug ’’zer/ ngas ‘dzugang du yod med khyod kyis blta bar rgyugs/ nga bcug sku da pas khong tsho'i mjug tu 'gro rgyu ma byung ’’zer lan bslogs pas/ dmag dpon de khong khro langs nas nga'i brang steng la khu tshur zhig bzhus te nga sa la 'gril grabs byas byung /ngas rgya dpon der mdun ngos kyi zas rigs blugs pa'i sder ma de lag tu blangs nablosdo zur slog ste gzhus pas sder ma chag da dung 'thung chas phor ba de yang blangs te bzhus pa dang chabs cig rdo gcig sgrug nas ‘6shog dang kwas khyod ra'i nyes rdung ngas gzed kyi ma red/ nga tsho'i mgo

dmag sgar btson khang du btson 'jug gi rgyud rim/ 77steng gi dpon po twa la'i bla ma da lta bzhugs yod/ nga'i mi tshe 'dir nang gi them pa ma mthong na'ang khyedad kyi 'og mapo sngo sgur mi thub/ nga mi gcig shi bar bod pa rdzogs rgyu ma red/ nga tsho'i lung pa khyod tshos btsan 'phrog byas pas ma zad/ da dung khrims 'gal ༷/gas dkrugs kyis bod mi spyi sger tshang ma'i mkhar dbang rgyu dngos yongs rdzogs btsan 'phrog byas pa ngo tsha yi mi 'dug gam ’’zhes kho la 'a(/ga pa brgyab pa yin/rgya dmag 'go dpon des ‘‘khyod rang nyen rtog par rtsis sprod bya rgyu yin ’’zer ngar ngar byed/ ngas ‘‘rtsis sprod dang mi sprod khyod kyi lag par yod/ khyod kyis shes dgos pa zhig la nga tsho'i dbu khrid 7gong sa 7skyabs mthodan chen sngo mchog nyin gcig bod du phebs rgyur nges pas sa cha 'di'i bdag po su yin khyod kyi mi shes na nges par du nga dza bod pa chod yin pa shes dgos/ btson khang nang yong don gang yin khyedad kyis mi shes na sa cha 'di thog nas khyod cho sa nga tsho'i mi gsod rgyu 'phrog ham pa gang 'asnga da ltar byas pa der ngo rgol dang khyod tsho'i nyes rdung gzed 'dod rme da par 'dir slebs song / ngas khyod kyi nyes rdung gzed dgos don med/ nga'i mi tshe gang po btson khang nang 'dug dgos rgyu ma red/ phyi la thon rjes khyod ltad mo ltos ang ’’zhes lan bache ga pa yin/ 'khrug pa rgyag bzhin pa'i skabs dmag mi mang sngo zhig sku nga ste nga la khyod khrims 'o/ga tu bsgyur bkod yag

78 mi rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsod/po mi byed par dmag dpon la 'khrug 'dzing byed pa tshabs chen red ces gshe gshe galta nga zhing lag pa nas 'jus te batho na khang nang drud/ ngas dmag mi tshor dzu‘dmag dakhrodan des don med nga la khu tshur brgyab/ gdong rgyag bzhus/ rdog brdzis gnon te rdung byung / don med la khos nyes rdung btang bar 〈cog nad theg gi mi 'dug byas pas/ dmag dpon des ngas bzhus med ’’ces ham bshad byed/ 'khrug pa byung rjes bod pa'i dmag dpon zhig bi/sa ‘‘de 'dra ma byed ces nga btson khang nang khrid nas dbugs ring nar nar byed/ ngas khong la khyed rang bod rang btsan byung rjes bod la bsdokyigs mkhan yin na nga zu+orgor gdung sems mnyam bskyed gnang dgos/rgya :pe mnyam du rgya nag la log mkhan yin na gnas dzaXl tha dad yin ’’zhes bshad pa yin/ de mjug gi nyin zhig dri zhib khang du dri rtsad byed par khrid byung / skabs der rgya mi dmag dpon de rlangs 'khor chung ngu zhig la bsdad de tshur bslebs so/nga yang / nga'i ngo gdong la blta tsam yang ma byas par shar rer phyin song / da dung ngas bshad pa'i skad cha rnams dri zhib nyen stodag par tshig gcig bshad mi 'dug gal srid ngas bshad pa'i skad cha dri zhib nyen the ga par cha tshang snyan seng byas tshe/ nga la nyes chad zhig gtong rgyu thag chod pa red/ nged gnyis 'khrug pa byung rjes btson khang de'i nang sdod ring rgya dmag dpon po des nga la 'khon 'dzin tsam mi byed par/ da

dmag sgar btson khang du btson 'jug gi rgyud rim/ 79dung ya mtshan che ba zhig la rgya rtsis kyi zla 8 tshes 15 nyin rgya ༷/gas kyi sku la ltar batho na pa tshor yang bag leb dang mngar cha ka ra sogs rngan pa nyung ngu re sprod srol 'dug pas/ de nyin rgya dpon des nga la sprod rgyu'i rngan pa rnams lta nga rang gi zhabs zhu'i lag tu bzhag nas nga la ster du bcugakhong rang rgyang ring nas bltas te bsdad 'dug 'khrug pa brgyab pa des nged rang la grags su gyur ba lta bu byung /rgya dmag 'go dngo na des nga rang bod la slebs nas lo ngo nyi shu tsam phyin song yang skye dman zhed snang chen po de 'dra da res ma gtogs masdu/nga myong med/ nga tsho gung khran tang yon yin min cha mi 'a'argal yang / khong chod bod pa'i gung khran tang sku na dngos gnas yin 'dug ces bshad pa rjes su thodas byung /nga'i sems la sdug bsngal gyi che ra ba lhad gnodan pa zhigaphyi lo 1989 lo'i phyi zla 9 pa'i nang glo bur nyin gcig sngo da rang skyong stodangs nyen rtog las khungs kyi mi sna kha shas yong ste/ ‘(sgrol ma (phyi rgyal ba bu med zhig)dang mnga' ris rin po che gnyis 'brel ba yod med ’’dri rtsad byed par slebs/ ngas khong gnyis ‘‘'brel ba yod med mi shes/ se ra'i mnga' ris rin po che mo rang la rgyus e yod ’’byas

8༷ mi rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsod/pas/ nyen rtog pas ‘d+nghamanga' ris rin po ches 'brel ba yod pa ngos len byas song ’’zer bshad byung /ngas dri zhib nyen rtog par mnga' ris rin lnga che nas ngos len byas na de rang red/ ngas khong gnyis 'brel ba yod med mi shes zer tshig gcig ma bshad/ nyen rtog mi snas skad cha drang po bshad na yag gi red/ khyedad kyi bza' zla sman khang nang 'chi la khad du yod pas/ khyod rang lta bar 'gro yi min nam zer bshad byung / kho nga gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i gnas tshul nga dang 'brel ba med ces khas len ma byas/ nyin gsum par don gnad 'di gcig pu'i thog yang bskyar 'dri rtsad byed par slebs/ de mjug dri zhib nyen rtog pas dngos 'brel bshad rgyu med pa bden pa red dam/ drang po ma bshad na rjes su rdzing rkub brdol na ci byed ces mtha' mjug gi dri ba de byas byung / ngas rjes su don rgyu'i gnas tshul gang yang med pa khrims dpang btsugs kyis bshad rgyu yin byas pas gnas tshul dri thag chod/nga'i bza' zla ni nyen rtog pas rtag tu nyen rtog las khungs nang btsan khrid kyis 'dri rtsad dang bcar rdung gis mgo bor me mda'i mjug shing bzhus te masku sngo rmas nas 'tshem bu drug tsam brgyab dgos byung ba dang /mthar lus po skyon can du gyur nas nyal sar lus/ nged rang btson khang nas phyi zla 9 mtshan mo zhig gi chu tshod bcu pa'i thog nyen rtog pas khong

dmag sgar btson khang du btson 'jus gi rgyud rim / 81thug tu thengs gcig khrid kyang bza' zla dpal ldan rdo rje lags ni sku gzugs sbrid po skyodan can du gyur nas gson pa'i re thag gting nas chad pa'i skyo sung ngal dub ya nga ba zhig khong gi ngo gdong las mngon pa ma zad skad cha sgra dag gsal po rgyag thub min gyi ngang lus shing / kho nga gi gnas stangs mthong skabs nga'i sems la sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba ljid gnon pa zhig byung / da dung 'chi nyer yod pa'i nad pa'i 'gram du btson ra'i do dam nyen stodag pa'i lag gi skud med kha par nas rna bar bsun pa'i skad cor sna tshogs shig brgyab nas nad pa/'i sems la sdug bsngal sbedan ma zhig bakhrodas/dus skabs der nga'i bu skal bzang nyi mas rgya gar nas bskyur ba'i yig lha/gas shig gi mdun du ‘ ‘pā lags/ a ma lags ’ ’zhes bris pa dang / rgyab tu bu pha ma dran nas mig chu shor bzhin pa'i ri mo zhig bris 'dug pa de khong gis ‘ ‘nga la yig slogs/ de bton te da thengs nga mi yong sa ma red ’ ’zer sems sdug tshad las 'das pa byed/ nga'i sems la skyo snang gi tshor shugs drag po zhig byung yang bzod bsran cher bskyed kyis khong la d+ngha ‘sems gso byed kyin snang dag dgos kyi ma red/ khyed kyi zhal mdangs rgas 'gyur gyi nyams gang yang thon mi 'dug gal srid bar chad byung na rngag par dpe cha mang po blta skru ga byed kyi sku da pas shul cir sems khral ma byed/ rngorgyal ba rin po che'i zhal ras sgom/ phru gu chung ba gnyis rgya

8na mi rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsod/gar tu slob grwar yod pas sems khral dgos kyi ma red/ 'dir yod bu phrug rnams la ngas nged gnyis kyi byams brtse bsdoms te byed thub kyi med na'ang chad kyi ma red ’’ces mtha' mjug gi skad cha de bshad pas nyen rtog pas nyen can pa zhig gi twa la'i bla ma sgom pa dang byin rlabs bzas na kho 'chi yi ma red dam zhes khong khros btson khang du khrid byung / btson khang nang 'gyor rjes bza' zla'i gnas stangs ya nga ba mig lam du 'char nas rang sems de mur mi gnas par mi skyid pa'i rang bzhin zhig byung ste mi la 'khrug pa thengs mang rgyag pa shor/dus yun ring po ma song bar mtshan mo zhig rmi lam nang d+ngha‘nga'i bza' zlas lag tu ja dam zhig dang phor pa kha chag cig bzung ste nga la ja ster du slebs/ khong gi gdong par lta skabs so rnams lhung nas med pa dang / gang byas te so lhang ba dri skabs nyen rtog pas gcar brdung byed drags nas chag ’’song zer/ ngas khyim du phor ba mang po yod pas kha chag bsnams nas gang byed ces dris song bas/ khong gis gang byed kyi ma red ces bshad/ ngas khyed 'dir yong na nyen rtog pas nyes rdung gtang rgyu ma zad nyes chad gcod rgyu red ces bshad song bas/ gang byed kyi ma red ces lan slog pa dang / de ma thag dngangs skrag gis gnyid hob bsad byas byung / rmi lam de btang ba nas nga'i sems ljid tig tig zhig chags pa

dmag sgar btson khang du brtsan 'jug gi rgyud rim/ 8 dang ring min gyi nyin gcig grong khyer lha sa'i nyen rtog las khungs kyi mi sna kha shas mo nga ste nga la ‘‘yar longs/ khyodad kyi khyed ka shi 'dug kha btags g.yog par 'gro dgos/ ngu ba so/gas byas na 'grig gi ma red ’’zer/ mi shi rkyen chag las thabs sdug pa'i gnas tshul zhig sku/nga rgyu min yang / khong tsho'i skad cha bshad stangs der khong khros nga tsho bod pa mi shi na ma gtogs ngu dgos rgyu ma red la kha btags g.yog tu'ang 'askra/ dgos pa zhig chags med ces sems pa skyo nas rang dbang med par ngu shor/btson khang du grong khyer lha sa'i nyen rtog las khungs kyi mi sna dang ‘‘bod rang skyong ljongs ’’nyen rtog las khungs kyi dpon rigs 'ga' shas kyang mnyam du 'dug kho nga chosas nga la dzu‘kha btsum/ kha btsum ’’zhes rlangs 'kho ra gcig nang bzhag ste khrid/ nyen rtewag las khungs nang slebs pa dang khong chos phan tshun kha par thog nas da slebs song zhes bshad sku nga bas nga'i bsam par nyen rtog las khungs kyi dpon rigs shig sku nga gi yod chodad bsam byung bas gang tsam nas nga'i bu mo nyi ma sgrol ma rlangs 'khor chung ngu zhig nang bzhag nas khrid byung / bu mo sa nga malnga nga ma thag ‘6a ma lags thug tu khrid pa red pas ’’zer gyis/ ngas ma red/ pā lags sku tshe zin mi 'dug byas pas/ bu mos rang gi pha 'das pa'i lha ra thos ma thag yid kyi mtsho mo ra sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag pos rang dbang med par mig nas

84 mi rabs gsum gyi 'thab rtsodad/ mchi ma phrum phrum du lhung ste nyen rtog par khyod cho ra mi shi rgyu med pa ma red/nga tshor 'di lta bu'i sdug po gtong don gang red/ nga tshor skyabs gnas 7rgyal ba rin po che bzhugs yod red ces ngu shor nas sdod mi thub/ der yod pa'i nyen rtog mi sna zhig gis 'di ni khyod tshos bzos pa red/ stodad ma tshugs nas chag sbed 'di byung ba red/ kha btsum nas ma bsdad na nang du khrid rgyu min zhes rdzig rdzig byed/ nga'i sems zhwa bzod mi bde ba'i sdug bsngal zhig yod mod/ codan kyang bu mor bzod bsran byed dbo sa/ bzod bsran byed dathodas zhes sems gse dang re ba bton/ nyen shodag las khungs nang dus yun chu tshod gsum bzhi tsam ring bkag ste dgong dro'i chu tshod 11thog nga dang bu mo mnyam du nang la khrid/nga'i khyim du spun mched dang / dga' nye blo dkar/ de bgīn grong pa khyim mtshes tshos rogs pa byed par mi sna du ma 'dzoms nas sku/da pa kho nga tshos shes te/ zang zing gi gnas tshul sku nga rgyu'i dogs gzhis dbo nga dro phyi por ma gtogs ma khrid pa red/ khyim sgo'i 'gram du slebs skabs ngas nyen rtog par chab gsang la gshedang gro gas byas pas/ 'grig gi ma red/gcin pa 'di ru thongs zer khong cho mtha' skor du yod sa'i dkyil du gtong du bcugabud med gcig mi mang po'i mdun—du chab gsang gtong rgyu ni dka' ngal dang ngo tsha'i rang bzhin zhig yin mod/ nyen stodag pas nga tshor
